full_details: By day the house was the house. The carrier is still the eighteenth, letters and not a chest. You had written nothing of the play in nine days, and you had meant to write nothing. The household list was not the play. The moon was up over the orchard wall a little before ten. You sat with a kitchen candle in a horn lantern, the inkhorn wedged in a knot-hole of the plank, and wrote what you had carried. She speaks first. About one, a casement opened. Anne asked who you were talking to. You said a girl at a window. You came in at half past two with a hundred and ninety lines, and a nurse calling Madam from within. The sheets stayed under the stone. The inkhorn stayed in the knot-hole. Two quills were beside it.
one_sentence: Under the full moon you wrote the orchard scene on the bench, and you left the sheets under the stone.
title: Wrote the orchard scene on the bench
